# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def resource_score(requested: int, capacity: int) -> int:
    if capacity == 0 or requested > capacity:
        return 0
    return ((capacity - requested) * 100) // capacity

def pod_index(pod: Pod, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> int:
    for i in range(len(ctx.pods)):
        p = ctx.pods[i]
        match = p.service == pod.service and p.app == pod.app and p.cpu_request == pod.cpu_request and p.mem_request == pod.mem_request and p.stateful == pod.stateful and p.has_pdb == pod.has_pdb and p.image_mb == pod.image_mb
        if match:
            return i
    return -1

def dependency_penalty(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    idx = pod_index(pod, ctx)
    if idx < 0:
        return 0.0
    penalty: float = 0.0
    for i in range(len(ctx.graph.src)):
        src = ctx.graph.src[i]
        dst = ctx.graph.dst[i]
        other = -1
        if src == idx:
            other = dst
        elif dst == idx:
            other = src
        if other >= 0:
            other_node = ctx.pods[other].current_node
            if other_node >= 0:
                lat = node.latency_to_ms[other_node]
                penalty += lat
    return penalty

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0
    cpu = resource_score(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request, node.cpu_capacity)
    mem = resource_score(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request, node.mem_capacity)
    headroom = min(cpu, mem)
    penalty = dependency_penalty(pod, node, ctx)
    score_val = float(headroom) - penalty * 0.01
    return score_val

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

    scaled = mean_latency_ms / 30.0

    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))

    mem_util = float(node.mem_allocated) / mem_cap
    return max(cpu_util, mem_util)

    target = state.nodes[target_idx]
    if target.suspended:
        return False
    cpu_cap = float(max(target.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(target.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_after = float(target.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem_after = float(target.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
    peak = max(cpu_after, mem_after)
    return peak < margin

    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0

    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))

    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
    peak = max(cpu_after, mem_after)
    if peak > 1.0:
        return -1000000.0

    headroom = 1.0 - peak
    headroom = headroom * headroom
    if peak > 0.85:
        headroom = headroom * 0.15
    elif peak > 0.75:
        headroom = headroom * 0.50
    elif peak > 0.65:
        headroom = headroom * 0.80

    if queue_headroom < 0.0:
        queue_headroom = 0.0

    weight = 0.0
    max_lat = 0.0
    edges = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        source = ctx.graph.src[e]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:

                lat = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]

        if ids[i] == target:
            return True
    return False

    if budget <= 0:
        return out

    moved = 0
    edges = len(graph.src)
    moved_ids: list[int] = []
    moved_targets: list[int] = []

    for e in range(edges):
        if moved >= budget:
            return out

        source_pod = state.pods[graph.src[e]]
        destination_pod = state.pods[graph.dst[e]]
        source_idx = source_pod.current_node
        dest_idx = destination_pod.current_node

        placed = source_idx >= 0 and dest_idx >= 0
        same = source_idx == dest_idx
        safe = not source_pod.stateful and not source_pod.has_pdb
        safe = safe and not destination_pod.stateful and not destination_pod.has_pdb
        fresh = not contains_id(moved_ids, source_pod.id)
        fresh = fresh and not contains_id(moved_ids, destination_pod.id)
        eligible = placed and not same and safe and fresh

        if eligible:
            source_node = state.nodes[source_idx]
            dest_node = state.nodes[dest_idx]
            sp = node_pressure(source_node)
            dp = node_pressure(dest_node)
            lat = source_node.latency_to_ms[dest_idx]

            pressure_gap = sp - dp
            if pressure_gap < 0.0:
                pressure_gap = 0.0 - pressure_gap

            power_gap = source_node.power_idle_w - dest_node.power_idle_w
            if power_gap < 0.0:
                power_gap = 0.0 - power_gap

            high_lat = lat > 10.0
            imbalanced = pressure_gap > 0.12
            power_beneficial = power_gap > 6.0
            beneficial = high_lat or imbalanced or power_beneficial

            if beneficial:
                source_ok = fits_with_margin(state, source_pod, dest_idx, 0.70)
                dest_ok = fits_with_margin(state, destination_pod, source_idx, 0.70)
                move_source = False
                move_dest = False

                if source_ok and dest_ok:
                    if sp > dp + 0.10:
                        move_source = True
                    elif dp > sp + 0.10:
                        move_dest = True
                    elif high_lat:
                        move_source = source_pod.image_mb <= destination_pod.image_mb
                        move_dest = not move_source
                    elif source_node.power_idle_w > dest_node.power_idle_w:
                        move_source = True
                    elif dest_node.power_idle_w > source_node.power_idle_w:
                        move_dest = True
                    else:
                        move_source = source_pod.image_mb <= destination_pod.image_mb
                        move_dest = not move_source
                elif source_ok:
                    move_source = True
                elif dest_ok:
                    move_dest = True

                if move_source and count_target(moved_targets, dest_idx) < 1:
                    out.append(move_pod(source_pod.id, dest_idx))
                    moved = moved + 1
                    moved_ids.append(source_pod.id)
                    moved_targets.append(dest_idx)
                elif move_dest and count_target(moved_targets, source_idx) < 1:
                    out.append(move_pod(destination_pod.id, source_idx))
                    moved = moved + 1
                    moved_ids.append(destination_pod.id)
                    moved_targets.append(source_idx)

    return out
